E0415

Section visibility labels `pub:` / `priv:` rejected

What

Section visibility labels `pub:` / `priv:` rejected

Why

Moving an item above or below a label would silently change its visibility

Fix

Delete the label; group internal declarations in a `priv module`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0415: tests/ui/vis_section_label.stderr.
